annual_basis_note: FX 5.0727 BRL/USD (BCB PTAX 2026-07-15). ECONOMICS DISPLAY-ONLY: Recife has NO waterborne passenger ridership series — the Rios da Gente river-transit system (R$289M program, 2012) was never delivered (<2% built by 2021, shelved by 2022) and its 300,000 pax/month design demand was a projection that was publicly criticized on cost-vs-demand grounds (JC mobility column, 2022). Series above are visitor/event/cruise proxies plus verified fare points from existing tourism boats; do not treat any of them as water-transit ridership.
